name: regression-exposed-stress-replay-20261008
purpose: Already-exposed development/stress reuse of exactly two previously measured regression origins. Not fresh confirmation. Only dataset role/prior_exposure are amended; original source, target, predictor, rights and source-split definitions are retained.
historical_annotations: Copied reservation IDs/roles and old source acquisition notes are historical provenance, not current admission authority. Current dataset role=development and prior_exposure=exposed govern reuse.

study_plan.amendment_timing: Explicit parent-approved pre-outcome plan on 2026-10-08; no new payloads or performance values were inspected to create this manifest.
study_plan.learner_meaning: linear is the runner's Ridge regression learner; the averaging method is the fixed 0.5 raw/FE study selected by the parent.
study_plan.budget_scope: ONE cumulative 14400-second ceiling across primary, infrared and hardware executions, not 14400 seconds per output directory. Parent allocates/enforces the remaining allowance; this descriptive manifest introduces no controller or cross-run budget mechanism.
study_plan.execution_policy: Use existing execution.execute with development roles and explicit dataset filtering. No confirmation preregistration, no new resplitting flag or loader changes.

primary_seven.legacy_rights_policy: Retain existing legacy-not-reviewed/cached-only labeling. This manifest grants no new acquisition or licensing approval for legacy inputs.
primary_seven.origin_policy: Energy Efficiency keeps its existing simulation designation; no source-origin relabeling.

infrared_stress.intake: May be selected alongside the primary seven under the same IID3/row-cap configuration, but must retain its separate result scope.

hardware_stress.intake: Separate execution with only this dataset, max_rows=0 and folds=10. Any nonzero cap is forbidden by the existing official-source provider, even though the source contains only 209 rows.
hardware_stress.seed_meaning: Seed42 configures model/internal evaluation randomness; it does not recreate or reshuffle the task-provided official folds.
hardware_stress.comparison_limit: A different split design from the earlier three-fold IID confirmation failure; NOT a replication of that IID failure.

reporting_constraints.scope: Report primary, infrared IID stress and hardware official-fold stress separately. Do not treat exposed stress selection as independent confirmation evidence or pool incompatible split designs.

datasets.name: computer-hardware-performance
datasets.prediction_time: Static published relative CPU performance PRP from machine cycle time, memory, cache and channel specifications. OpenML names PRP class. Estimated ERP is absent, as are vendor/model identifiers.
datasets.evaluation_limitations: Different origin from exposed cpu-act, which is Sun Sparcstation 20/712 activity telemetry predicting usr. Do not treat ERP fitted by the original authors as a predictor or a new outcome. No future hardware-generation claim.

rights.approval_basis: Original UCI dataset publication explicitly licenses this data under CC BY 4.0; the OpenML Public/license badge is not the grant relied upon.
rights.scope: Metadata-only candidate reservation now; later acquisition/use only after explicit parent release and protocol freeze. Local scientific processing only, no hosted row sharing or individual high-stakes deployment.
rights.obligations: Retain original source/contributor attribution, dataset and paper citations, and describe all curation/target/timing limitations.

source.categorical_rule: All NOMINAL and STRING predictors are categorical unless explicitly excluded; no value-cardinality heuristics or model outcomes.
source.payload_sha256_status: Not acquired. Original upstream MD5 is a metadata pin, not evidence that payload bytes have been verified.

datasets.name: infrared-oral-temperature
datasets.prediction_time: Contemporaneous oral temperature in monitor mode from measured infrared temperatures, demographic categories and acquisition conditions. Exclude fast-mode oral temperature and SubjectID; not fever diagnosis or future illness prediction.
datasets.evaluation_limitations: This is a heterogeneous clinical measurement/calibration table, not a homogeneous pixel benchmark. IRT-2 and repeated camera/location variants share this origin and are not separate families. No identifiable images, subject reidentification, individual clinical use or hosted row transfer is approved.

rights.approval_basis: UCI explicitly delegates licensing to the linked original data. PhysioNet face-oral-temp-data v1.0.0 is Open Access with an explicit CC0 1.0 grant for the de-identified data files; no UCI default license is assumed.
rights.scope: Metadata-only candidate reservation now; later acquisition/use only after explicit parent release and protocol freeze. Local scientific processing only, no hosted row sharing or individual high-stakes deployment.
rights.obligations: Retain original source/contributor attribution, dataset and paper citations, and describe all curation/target/timing limitations.

source.payload_sha256_status: Not acquired; reported shape and reviewed schema require payload verification after explicit release.
